retrieval.parameters: action=query, prop=extracts|revisions, revids=<pinned revision>, rvprop=ids|timestamp, rvslots=main, explaintext=1, format=json, formatversion=2
retrieval.savedFormat: UTF-8 plaintext extract, without added newline

sources.title: Harshen Hausa
sources.licenseBasis: I use the revision's post-2023-06-07 contribution license.
sources.attribution: I attribute the pinned text to Harshen Hausa on Hausa Wikipedia, revision 873901, and link to the revision history through the pinned URL.
sources.currentDemoUse: I use selected, source-tagged words in data/demo-lexicon.tsv; I make no trained-language-model claim from the small extract.
transformations: I requested the pinned revision by ID.
I saved the API plaintext extract as UTF-8 without adding a newline.
I keep the raw file outside Git.
I retain Hausa diacritics and normalize words to NFC in my Julia statistics step.

licenseContext.summary: I assign the license per pinned revision, not per current wiki hostname.

derivedArtifacts.transformation: I normalize extracted text to NFC, lowercase Unicode letter-plus-mark tokens, count each token by language and pinned revision, and sort by language, revision, descending count, then word.
derivedArtifacts.use: I use the counts only to rank selected source-tagged demo words; I do not treat one article per language as representative.
